# Vendored codex custom-tools rollout fixture

`rollout.jsonl` is a SANITIZED copy of one real Codex CLI rollout journal
from this host (`~/.codex/sessions`, 2026-09-26, cli 0.147.0, model
`glm-5.2` behind a proxy provider). It is the golden corpus for the rm-542
custom-tools parsing tests (`codex_custom_tools_rollout_parses_calls_reasoning_and_disclosure`
in `crates/agenttrace-core/src/parser.rs`).

## Why this fixture exists

The research census (run b1ff12f8, 2026-10-05) of the six newest real
rollouts on this host found the custom-tools API dominant — 7–20
`response_item/custom_tool_call` + `custom_tool_call_output` pairs per
session, standalone `response_item/reasoning` items, and a new top-level
`world_state` — with ZERO classic `function_call` records. Before rm-542
every one of those payload types fell to the parser's `_ => {}` arm, so
those sessions reported `tool_calls_total = 0`, `tool_results = 0`, and
`reasoning_blocks = 0` while real tool work happened.

## Sanitization policy

Wire structure is preserved; content is scrubbed (60 string values
replaced). Specifically:

- every line, JSON key, type discriminator, id/call_id, status,
  timestamp, and numeric value (including `token_count` snapshots) is
  preserved;
- free-text payloads (user/developer/assistant messages, reasoning
  summary texts, tool inputs, tool outputs, instruction bodies) are
  replaced with deterministic placeholders;
- host-identifying paths and repo coordinates (`cwd`,
  `workspace_roots`, git url/branch/commit) are replaced with neutral
  values.

The scrub is metrics-neutral: parsing the sanitized fixture yields the
same tool/turn/token counters the unsanitized original yields.

## Census (pinned)

- 51 lines: 1 `session_meta`, 1 `world_state`, 1 `turn_context`,
  28 `response_item` (7 `custom_tool_call`, 7 `custom_tool_call_output`,
  9 `message`, 5 standalone `reasoning`), 20 `event_msg` (8 `token_count`,
  5 `agent_reasoning`, 4 `agent_message`, 1 `user_message`,
  1 `task_started`, 1 `task_complete`)
- 0 classic `function_call` records
- every `custom_tool_call` carries `status: "completed"` (the corpus
  contained no failure-status example; the failure arm is pinned by an
  inline synthetic test instead)
- reported usage pins: 23,312 input / 9,790 output / 192,128 cache read,
  `model_used = glm-5.2`

- sha256: `c32074ff8a709aa2415cd0d1bcef1acbf0d95ef77830a2569cf277b3ae3f05e2`

Do not edit this file. To refresh, re-copy a current rollout, re-run the
sanitizer policy above (structure preserved, content scrubbed, metrics
re-verified identical to the original's live parse), and update the sha256
and pinned census — a mismatch means the golden corpus has drifted and the
pinned test totals must be re-measured, not transcribed.
